scripts.check: npm run app:check && npm run server:check
scripts.app:check: npm --workspace App run build && npm --workspace App run lint && npm --workspace App run test
scripts.server:dev: cd Server && uv run python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000

scripts.server:seed: cd Server && uv run python manage.py seed_bauwerksdiagnostik
